target_definition: readmitted == '<30' (readmission within 30 days) vs. all other outcomes
split_method: GroupShuffleSplit by patient_nbr, test_size=0.2, random_state=42 (prevents the same patient's encounters appearing in both train and test)
known_limitations: Not clinically validated; do not use for clinical decisions.
No drift monitoring, formal approval, or rollback process (see ROADMAP.md Phase 5 model-governance gate).

Probabilities are calibrated via cross-validated CalibratedClassifierCV (see brier_score above for calibration quality), but this has not been externally validated against a held-out calibration cohort separate from the training data.
Subgroup ROC-AUC is reported for visibility, not fairness certification.
Predictions applied to the full bundled dataset include rows the model was trained on; scores for those rows may be optimistic relative to true held-out performance.
